meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能直接调用 dial 命令:用已配好的真实号码发短信、打 AI 语音电话、接收短信/验证码,还能管理号码并等待来电/通话结束事件;密钥已注入,无需配置。
howto.when: 当你说到电话、短信、语音、验证码(2FA/OTP)等,或请它给某人发短信/打电话/等验证码时触发;会话中首次运行 dial 命令前也会载入。

say.note: Claude 会运行 dial message 发送短信。

say.text: 给 +14155550123 打个 AI 语音电话,让它说“您好”。
say.note: Claude 会运行 dial call 并跟踪通话结果。

say.text: 等一个发到这个号码的短信验证码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the dial CLI with a ready real phone number: send SMS, place AI voice calls, receive inbound texts/codes, manage numbers, and wait for events. The API key is injected automatically; no setup or credentials are needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP/2FA or verification codes, asks to text/call/wait for a code, before the first dial command in a session, or when exploring Dial's features.

say_en.note: Claude runs dial message to send it.

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 and have the AI voice agent say "Hi".
say_en.note: Claude runs dial call and tracks the call.

say_en.text: Wait for an SMS verification code sent to this number.
say_en.note: Claude runs dial wait-for for inbound SMS.
